subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR wait for visible latest-head proof of the legacy no-code SQLite upgrade path, or may maintainers accept the current source/tests plus summarized manual result?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but external PR proof is still incomplete for the compatibility-sensitive upgraded persisted-state path, and only a maintainer can waive that proof gate.

options.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code diagnostics_json row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds on this head.

options.title: Accept Current Evidence
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept the source proof, regression tests, CI, and summarized manual result as enough for this upgrade path.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup Out Of Runtime
options.body: Pause this PR and require the no-code legacy cleanup to live in doctor or migration-owned code if runtime invalidation is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code diagnostics_json row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds on this head.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc gave the predecessor's explicit-marker direction and is the clearest owner for deciding whether the follow-up proof satisfies that direction.
